behaviorChanges: Snapshot-store integrity: the generated launcher refuses to pin a `current` whose manifest-verified name does not match the canonical checkout's HEAD (announced on stderr, executes the checkout, never blocks a launch; fails open when HEAD is unanswerable), and the launcher-gate freshness stamp no longer authorizes a skip when it recorded a sync that left the store behind -- heal retries on the next launch instead of starving for a freshness window.

Package-mode isolation: installed packages stand the snapshot store down entirely (no heal, no pin refresh, no freshness stamp) and read-only reporters no longer remote-probe a leftover configured checkout; `snapshot-status` says so with an explicit standdown line.

Snapshot-store diagnostics: a snapshot dir vanishing mid-listing (concurrent prune) no longer empties the store report; store fault warnings name the actual fault for full-disk, quota, read-only and stale mounts, and I/O errors (permissions and unknown errnos keep the "store unreadable" default); the degrade warnings route to stderr through their single choke point so `snapshot-status` stdout stays machine-parseable; and a failed pin refresh reports instead of degrading silently.

Registry package: the generated pyproject pins the hatchling major; the wheel's .snapshot-meta.json stamps the source commit date instead of wall-clock (byte-reproducible builds); `registry-package` refuses a symlinked _dist loudly.

Release contract: renderer-kit dependency pins (package.json + lockfile) are exempt from the VERSION-bump gate, so Dependabot npm bumps can merge as raised; a change touching a lockfile AND framework code still requires the bump.

optionalMigrations.description: Snapshot-store machines: regenerate installed launchers with `tautline install-claude-launcher --force` to pick up the stale-current refusal (a `current` left behind the canonical HEAD by a failed publish is no longer pinned; the launcher warns and executes the canonical checkout), the worktree-armed guard, and the shell maintainer-mode parser that understands hand-edited quoted/commented exports. Existing launchers keep working unchanged until regenerated.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.1 restores the previous launcher template for NEWLY generated launchers only; launchers regenerated under 0.10.2 keep their refusal/parser until regenerated again (they are self-contained shell).
The stamp-veto and standdown changes roll back cleanly: no on-disk format moved, and a store healed under 0.10.2 is byte-identical to one healed under 0.10.1.
